creatures.name: 青芽海龟
creatures.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: isolated static character concept master for the existing Chinese anime aquarium game “天使水族馆”, v2.0. Generate ONE complete juvenile sea turtle called 青芽海龟, not a sheet or an illustration scene.
Visual style: polished 2D Japanese-anime aquarium collectible, precise thin dark navy/green contours, broad readable cel-shaded color blocks with gentle painted gradients and small controlled highlights; cute but graceful proportions, expressive emerald anime eye, same visual family as a pastel anime seahorse, jellyfish, octopus and leaf-pattern fish. Flat illustrated art, not 3D plastic or plush.
Subject: emerald/jade-green slightly domed shell with a simple readable arrangement of large shell plates, a lighter green rim, creamy ivory neck and underside, soft green skin, a rounded friendly head with a small closed mouth. FOUR broad sea-turtle flippers total, two longer front flippers and two shorter rear flippers, one tiny tail; anatomically coherent and visibly attached. No walking legs. No plants growing out of the shell.
Pose: body is almost horizontal, nose points RIGHT, shallow three-quarter SIDE view from only slightly above so the shell is visible. Calm neutral swimming posture; near front flipper gently angled downward, far front flipper separated and visible, hind flippers identifiable. Entire animal including all flipper tips and tail is within frame. Maintain a clean silhouette with room for later flipper animation; keep limbs from merging into the shell.
Composition: square canvas, one centered full-body creature fills about 78–84% of width, balanced clear margin all around, no inset or additional views. Calm friendly character readable at small game size.
Background: actual transparent alpha, isolated cutout. No sea, floor, bubbles, scenery, decorative objects, text, labels, frame, watermark, contact shadow, surrounding glow or checkerboard painted into the image. This is a first static selection concept, not animation frames.

creatures.name: 绮霞古比
creatures.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / character redesign.
Asset type: a new distinct 2D anime aquarium collectible concept for 天使水族馆 v2.0.

Image 1 is the previous crowned blue guppy concept to REDESIGN. Image 2 is the established 晴蓝鱼 from the SAME game, a STYLE AND QUALITY REFERENCE only. The old guppy looks too much like 晴蓝鱼 because both have a blue plump round body, big eye and similar fan-tail silhouette. Create a clearly different guppy species with a warm princess-like palette and a more graceful guppy silhouette, while matching Image 2's polished cute 2D anime craft.

ONE new fish, full body, side view facing RIGHT.
DESIGN CHANGES:
- Body color becomes luminous soft APRICOT-GOLD / creamy butter-yellow with a warm ivory belly, restrained peach shading and no blue anywhere in the body or fins.
- Body becomes a smaller, more slender oval, about 1.6 times as long as it is tall, with a gentle taper into a clearly defined slim tail stem. Keep an adorable rounded face; do not use the previous almost-ball body or a pufferfish shape.
- The large showy tail is the main new silhouette: a beautifully drawn open fan, broad and graceful with three soft scalloped lobes, a raspberry-rose center grading toward rosy pink and light peach tips, a very fine warm-ivory edge. Tail height about 1.2 times the body height; tail occupies roughly 35–40% of the total length. Few flowing curved fin divisions and subtly translucent petal-like membranes. It should look like a colorful guppy fan tail, not an enormous betta wedding dress, torn ribbons or a heart-shaped tail.
- Dorsal and small paired fins coordinate in raspberry/rose and warm peach, with restrained graceful curves. Keep fin count coherent and attachments clear.
- Use a large gentle ruby-plum anime iris, white sclera, well-designed simple highlights and a friendly tiny open smile. A soft apricot cheek accent, no human eyelashes or makeup.
- Keep the little royal crown as the only fantasy accessory, but make it SMALLER and more delicate than Image 1: a simple champagne-gold three-point crown, tiny rounded tips, neat base band, clear illustrated light/shadow. It must not dominate the fish or be the sole way to tell this species apart.
- No printed body symbols, dense shiny scales or rows of white crescent stamps. Let the warm body, slim silhouette and rose fan tail distinguish the creature. No jewelry, pearls, wings, flowers or extra props.

STYLE/QUALITY: match the refined cute anime illustration quality of Image 2: elegant variable-weight dark-plum contour, precise tapering inner lines, lively expressive face, clear cel-shaded color regions with gentle controlled gradients, beautifully designed highlights and subtle reflected color. Sophisticated and carefully drawn, with enough fin and face detail to feel finished. Keep broad readable shapes. Detail comes from drawing and color design, not photorealistic scale textures or 3D material shading. Not a crude flat icon, not plastic, not photorealistic. Do not copy Image 2's exact face marks, blue colors, round proportions or tail design.

Composition: ONE complete fish centered in a landscape-friendly canvas, balanced 10–12% transparent margins, full tail/crown/fin tips comfortably inside the frame, neutral horizontal swimming pose suitable for later animation. No other fish, comparison panels, labels or swatches.
Genuinely transparent alpha background. No water, scenery, floor, bubbles, cast shadow, external glow/aura, text, frame, watermark or painted checkerboard.

creatures.name: 珊澜蝶鱼
creatures.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / markings and palette redesign.
Asset type: refined 2D anime tropical butterflyfish static master.

Edit the supplied fish. KEEP its short deep butterflyfish body, side profile facing RIGHT, short pointed snout, compact paddle tail, continuous dorsal/anal fins, small pectoral fin, eye placement, friendly smile and overall framing. Preserve the polished hand-drawn anime style and delicate fin drawing.

USER FEEDBACK: The purple recolor feels bruised/poisoned. The eye-band concept is interesting, but the hard stripe cutting through the face and the dark oval sticker-like spot both need a different, more attractive implementation. Redesign the MARKINGS and their relationship to the body, not merely change their hue.

NEW PALETTE:
Warm pearly IVORY-WHITE is the main body and face color, with light peach cel-shadows. Use fresh CORAL / light tangerine-red on the upper back and fin membranes, clearly coral-orange rather than gold/yellow or fuchsia/purple. A small amount of light AQUA / seafoam blue accents fin edges and the short tail. Keep the face bright and warm, and the teal-green anime iris. No purple, magenta, black patches, bruised shadowing or neon mint wash.

EYE-BAND REDESIGN:
REMOVE the original broad dark vertical band completely.
In its place, draw ONE slim, gently CURVED aqua/teal marking that hugs ONLY THE REAR/LEFT perimeter of the visible eye (the fish faces right). It starts just above and behind the eye, sweeps softly behind the eye in a short crescent/wave, and tapers to a fine end on the upper cheek. It is a natural skin marking, not eyeliner or an extra fin. It must NOT cross the pupil, nose or mouth, run to the belly, divide the forehead, form a full ring or surround the whole face.
Use a light turquoise center with a slightly deeper muted teal contour, subtly integrated with the skin, about one quarter the visual weight of the previous stripe. Leave a generous ivory face and eye surround. No black/dark-purple paint, mask, clown makeup or superhero eye mask.

SPOT REDESIGN:
REMOVE the single large opaque dark oval on the rear upper flank completely.
Replace it with a SMALL CLUSTER of THREE delicate irregular warm peach/coral markings near the rear shoulder/back transition. Each is a small petal-like scale patch, varying slightly in size and angle, softly integrated with the upper-back color. No heavy outlines; no perfect black ovals, concentric eyespots, big circles, literal flowers, jewels or floating objects. Keep the rest of the ivory flank clean. The markings should feel like a tasteful natural tropical fish pattern rather than stickers.

FINISH:
Elegant tapered indigo linework, clear 2D anime cel-shaded color regions with soft limited gradients, lively large anime eye with simple designed highlights, beautifully drawn but restrained fin-ray lines. Friendly, fresh, cute tropical-fish personality. Keep craftsmanship; no crude flat icon, dense realistic scales, photorealism, 3D/plastic materials or excessive shiny highlights. No crown, clothing or new accessories.

One complete fish, all tips comfortably inside frame, similar margins. Preserve actual transparent alpha outside the character. No scenery, water, bubbles, floor, shadow, backdrop, surrounding glow, text, label, border, watermark or painted checkerboard.
